source.snippet: I've a few services that currently use a chat service and a cli client to generically send notifications from various apps. I'd like something similar without being tied to a chat client. Something self hosted I need to be able to run this behind nginx as a proxy... I can do docker if need be.

problem_statement: Self-hosting operators and small dev teams need a self-hosted web push notification server that decouples app notifications from third-party chat clients, runs behind a reverse proxy, and supports standard browser push APIs without vendor lock-in.
target_segment: Independent developers, small SaaS operators, and self-hosters running multiple web services who want to own their notification infrastructure
notes: Single clear signal but from a technical operator with real infrastructure (multiple services, nginx, docker comfort). Existing paid options (OneSignal, Knock, Novu cloud) suggest willingness to pay for a managed self-hosted or SaaS alternative. Pain is operational dependency on a chat client for notifications. Moderate signal strength — one post, no explicit WTP stated, but professional context is clear.
